yes, I recognized this issue but we are rendering these 2 markers as 2 separate elements. A solution is needed to anchor one element to the center of another. I'm thinking about this.

We give the map the `lat/long` for the each icon. We give the same lat/long to put them in the same place.

issues.title: Mapping changes for close-in wargames
issues.body:
The games that used the mapping feature in the past were performed on a map that covered 10s or hundreds of miles.

In the next wargame we wish to investigate supporting wargames running on a much smaller scale.

* [x] Create wargame covering a few miles, with small hex cells
* [x] Create `Asset` icon that is capable of showing current orientation (according to planned route)
* [x] Create `Asset` icon that is capable of showing orientation according to some asset attribute.

Calculate Asset orientation as one of these:
* [x] Value of direction to next planned step, if specified
* [x] Value of direction from most recent history, if specified
* [x] Absolute value of attribute
* [x] Value of attribute relative to heading
